description: Complete transformation summary: Project-Scoped Template Filtering Implementation - from 95% to 100% multi-tenant isolation compliance

instructionalToFunctionalBridge.desired: Support project-level isolation within organizations for activity templates. Users should be able to create templates scoped to their specific project (scope='project') and only see templates matching their project context.
instructionalToFunctionalBridge.implemented: Extended SessionData model with org_id and project_id fields. Modified 7 components across authentication, actions, database, and API layers to extract, validate, pass through, and filter by project_id. Removed TODO skip logic for project-scoped templates.
instructionalToFunctionalBridge.verified: 8/8 validation tests PASS (code-level). Harness tests session creation, template registration, user isolation within same org, cross-org isolation, unauthenticated access, API validation, filtering logic, and backward compatibility.
